name: MagNet N87 piecewise-linear core loss, ambient (R22.1X13.7X7.9 toroid)

properties.method: MagNet large-signal measurement, piecewise-linear (triangular / trapezoidal) excitation

evidence.description: Large-signal core-loss measurement of a toroid under piecewise-linear excitation.

provenance.normalization: CSV columns mapped one to one (dataset_metadata.csv); T degC -> K; flux_density_peak = B_pkpk / 2, i.e. (max B - min B) / 2 (the MagNet amplitude definition; B_pkpk equals max - min of B_vec to 1e-15 T); the published B_pkpk and the five-point piecewise-linear waveform (t_vec, B_vec) are kept verbatim.

name: MagNet N87 piecewise-linear core loss, variable-temperature (R34.0X20.5X12.5 toroid)

properties.method: MagNet large-signal measurement, piecewise-linear (triangular / trapezoidal) excitation

evidence.description: Large-signal core-loss measurement of a toroid under piecewise-linear excitation.

provenance.normalization: CSV columns mapped one to one (dataset_metadata.csv); T degC -> K; flux_density_peak = B_pkpk / 2, i.e. (max B - min B) / 2 (the MagNet amplitude definition; B_pkpk equals max - min of B_vec to 1e-15 T); the published B_pkpk and the five-point piecewise-linear waveform (t_vec, B_vec) are kept verbatim.

notes: Same MagNet measurement campaign as the packaged Princeton MagNet N87 database, processed separately: in a 3,000-row sample about two thirds of the rows match a packaged row within 0.1 % in f, 1 % in B and 2 % in P_v, while the canonical exact-match rule (0.1 % in f, B and P_v) matches about 1 %. Linked as a duplicate so it is not counted as an independent measurement.
